sources.note: Main product page: full suite description (EHR, PM, billing, optical POS, patient engagement), target market, efficiency claims, 30+ years serving 'thousands' of practices
ONC certification details, cost disclosures (EyeClinic.net and DrFirst Rcopia per-provider fees), CQM list, real-world testing docs 2022-2025, API/EHI export documentation links
Company history: founded 1994 by Nitin Rai in Hillsboro OR, milestones timeline (first eye-care ONC cert 2013, first Cures Act live test 2020), mission and values
EHR features: structured clinical documentation, SOAP notes, customizable exam templates, coding triggers, diagnostic equipment integration, e-prescribing, patient portal
Optical POS module: frame catalog management, barcode scanning, inventory tracking, lab order management, insurance integration for optical benefits
Optometry-specific features: customizable exam templates for optometric workflows, equipment integrations, EVAA AI automation
Image management: OCTs, fundus cameras, visual field analyzers, autorefractors, tonometers; cloud HIPAA-compliant storage; side-by-side longitudinal comparison
Billing/RCM: end-to-end claims management, claim scrubbing with payer-specific rules, ERA/EOB auto-posting, accounts receivable tracking
Support metrics: 97-98% customer satisfaction in quarterly surveys (2023-2024), 99% virtual support, <30 second response time
Cures Act compliance statement: no information blocking practices, EyeClinic.net portal delivers USCDI/EHI, API access auto-enabled via patient portal
FHIR R4 endpoint directory: 500+ practices listed with unique identifiers, format: fhir.maximeyes.com/api/{practice-id}/R4
25th anniversary post (2019): company growth history, founding story, 'thousands' of customers claim
EVAA AI suite launch (Sept 2025): Virtual Assistant, Billing Assistant, Scribe, Intelliscan; debuted at Vision Expo West
Brand refresh (June 2025): new visual identity, first-insight.com permanently redirects to maximeyes.com
Mango Voice VoIP partnership (Nov 2025): telephony integration with EHR for front-office automation
U.S. Vision deal (2018): selected MaximEyes for 600+ locations, converted 3M+ exam records from ExamWRITER
Black Book 2017 survey: #2 nationwide ophthalmology EHR (922 participants, 692 practices), #1 in decision support; HQ in Hillsboro OR, ~50 employees
Third-party review: 4/5 stars, pricing from $350/month, feature summary, pros (user-friendly, customizable) and cons (post-update glitches, scalability concerns)
User reviews: praised for user-friendliness and customization; concerns about occasional slowness and post-update issues
MaximEyes compliance with HL7 and IHE interoperability standards
The Eye Consortium (TEC) partnership: joined alliance group to expand reach to member practices
